description: This file defines a class `SambaNovaEmbeddingConfig` which provides configuration and transformation methods for integrating SambaNova's embedding API within a language model framework. The class includes methods for URL construction, environment validation, parameter mapping, request and response transformation, and error handling. It is a core part of a larger system that handles embeddings via SambaNova's API.

classes.name: SambaNovaEmbeddingConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for SambaNova embeddings, providing methods to generate request URLs, validate environment variables, handle parameters, and transform API responses.

methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI-style parameters for the API (currently empty).
